subject: Pricing & compliance: RegionPay expansion — KYC + pricing exception request
messages:
From: Emma Kowalski <emma@regionpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:52:00Z
Subject: Pricing + KYC for RegionPay (EMEA/APAC expansion)
Attachments: RegionPay_KYC_v1.pdf

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — RegionPay is keen to move quickly. We're planning to roll Redwood into our fraud-detection workflow for merchants in EMEA and APAC. High level ask: we need a commercial proposal with a 30% early-adopter discount for the first 12 months and the ability to guarantee EU data residency for EU customers.

I've attached a short KYC pack (company registry, ownership chart). Note that we operate through local subsidiaries in several markets, and a small portion of our merchant flow touches markets that usually require enhanced screening — we flagged that in the KYC. Happy to share more detail under NDA. Can we get pricing + confirmation on data locality and any compliance blockers within 48 hours?

If helpful, here's our SOW draft: https://docusign.com/REDACTED/sow-regionpay

Best,
Emma Kowalski
Head of Partnerships
RegionPay

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pricing + KYC for RegionPay (EMEA/APAC expansion)
Attachments: Signed_SOW_draft.docx

Team — forwarding a lead asking for a 30% discount + EU data residency guarantee. KYC attached. Compliance note: they call out "markets requiring enhanced screening." Vivek, can you confirm whether this is a hard block or EDD (enhanced due diligence) only?

Marissa — this exceeds the standard sales playbook discount (30% vs our usual 15% cap for self-serve). Can Deal Desk/RevOps advise: is an approval path available for this range, and what exec approvals do we need for non-standard terms?

Customer timeline: they want pricing + confirmation within 48 hours. My suggestion: offer an interim commercial with a smaller initial credit while compliance completes checks, but don't promise residency until we confirm infra/contractual support.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing + KYC for RegionPay (EMEA/APAC expansion)
Attachments: deal_summary.xlsx

Rishi — thanks for flagging. Quick points from Deal Desk:

- Pricing: 30% is material and outside standard delegated authority. Anything >20% needs VP Rev sign-off (we'll escalate to Sales Ops + Finance). Please provide expected ACV, contract length, and logo/reference value.
- Data residency: we can commit to EU-only processing for EU customers, but that requires a scoped DPA addendum and engineering confirmation on routing. Legal will need to sign off on the addendum.
- Compliance: if there is exposure to higher-risk jurisdictions, we need results from sanctions screening before presenting final terms.

My ask: Rishi, capture ACV and a short commercial memo (1 page) so I can start the approval packet. I'll tentatively propose a 10% early-adopter credit as an interim offer pending full compliance/EDD.

Marissa
Senior Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing + KYC for RegionPay (EMEA/APAC expansion)
Attachments: sanctions_screening_report.csv

Rishi/Marissa — ran an initial automated screen on the entities in the KYC packet. Summary: one beneficial owner returned a partial match against a consolidated watchlist entry (name similarity + country of residence overlap). That does not automatically prohibit engagement, but it elevates the transaction to enhanced due diligence (EDD).

Required next steps for us to progress:
- Obtain verified UBO documentation for all listed shareholders (government ID + corporate filings).
- Obtain a signed attestation confirming no material contracts in restricted sectors (defense, dual-use, regulated financial services in sanctioned jurisdictions).
- Confirm ultimate operational footprint: if we can limit processing for EU customers to EU-only infrastructure and restrict APAC rollout until clearance, that reduces risk.
- Legal/Governance must review the EDD packet and sign off — recommend we escalate to GC and CISO for final decision.

Given the time pressure from the customer, we can offer a conditional interim commercial (Marissa's 10% credit) but must include a clause: "final pricing and onboarding contingent on completion of EDD and compliance sign-off."

I'll prepare a formal escalation brief with the screening data and proposed mitigation. For now, treat this as P0 compliance hold until we receive docs.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Compliance & Trust | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Kowalski <emma@regionpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing + KYC for RegionPay (EMEA/APAC expansion)

Hi Emma — appreciate the fast follow. Quick update from our side: we've routed the KYC to Compliance and Deal Desk. Compliance returned an initial screen that requires enhanced due diligence. To keep things moving, we can offer a provisional 10% early-adopter credit for a 12-month term while we complete the EDD, but final pricing and onboarding will be conditional on compliance sign-off.

To complete EDD, please send the following at your earliest convenience:
- Verified UBO list (names, % ownership) with supporting government ID for each UBO
- Certificate of incorporation for each operating entity and recent corporate registry extracts
- Confirmation of primary operating countries for the Redwood-integrated workload (we need to confirm whether any processing will occur in restricted jurisdictions)
- Signed attestation stating RegionPay does not provide regulated services in restricted/controlled sectors for the merchants we plan to onboard

We expect EDD to take up to 5 business days once we have complete docs. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call with Compliance to walk through the requirements. In the meantime I'll prepare a minimal commercial memo for Deal Desk to start the approval workflow.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
